info.title: Power System Overview
info.copy: Utility power steps down to 10kV and transfers with a 10kV diesel source at the interlocked MV ATS. A 10/0.38kV transformer, LV distribution and UPS then supply the micro module.

eq.d500: Overhead 500kV utility intake, protection and outgoing feeder aggregation
eq.d220: Steps 500kV down to 220kV as the campus high-voltage supply
eq.d10: Receives the 10kV output from the main transformer for protection, metering and feeders
eq.dTransformer: Steps 10kV medium voltage down to 380V three-phase low voltage
eq.dLv: Receives 380V three-phase output and handles low-voltage distribution branches
eq.dAts: Metal-clad MV lineup with utility and 10kV generator incomers, bus metering/control and a transformer feeder. Protection and control interlock the vacuum breakers for break-before-make transfer, preventing unsynchronized source paralleling. The transferred 10kV supply reaches the transformer before stepping down to 380V.
eq.dUps: Online double-conversion UPS: 380V AC → DC → 380V AC
eq.dBattery1: UPS DC energy storage that instantly supports the load during a utility outage
eq.dBattery2: Parallel UPS battery extension cabinet for longer backup runtime
eq.dGen: This scene uses a 10kV diesel generator. Once voltage and frequency stabilize, interlocked MV ATS connects it to the transformer, which steps down to 380V. UPS batteries support IT loads during startup and transfer.
eq.dPdu: UPS output distribution feeding the data hall busway
eq.dRack: Rack PDU powers server PSUs; internal power shelves convert to 48V DC
eq.dModule: Micro module functional schematic: facing rack rows, transparent aisle roof, sliding end doors, in-row cooling, overhead cabling and an end-mounted monitoring screen. A 380V busway and rack PDUs supply the IT equipment.
eq.dCooling: Cooling units alongside IT racks supply the contained cold aisle. This is a functional schematic.
